    iStateStep := 90; (* Jump directly to STATE_EMERGENCY_RETRACT_BLOWDOWN_TRIP *)
END_IF;

(* Continuous Critical Boundary Fault Supervision *)
IF (iStateStep >= 30) AND (iStateStep <= 50) THEN
    (* 1. Wafer Slippage / Fly-Out Hazard: Loss of Vacuum or Severe Pocket Pressure Drop *)
    IF (rCarrierVacuum_kPa > 85.0) AND (rPolishingElapsed_Sec > 3.0) THEN
        bTrip_WaferSlip_Latched := TRUE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;

    (* 2. Pad Surface Thermal Runaway: Exceeding 62.0 deg C damages polyurethane foam matrix *)
    IF rPadTemperature_degC > 62.0 THEN
        bTrip_PadOverheat_Latched := TRUE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;

    (* 3. Slurry Starvation Hydroplaning Collapse: Dry friction generates catastrophic wafer fracture *)
    IF (rSlurryFlow_Filt_mLmin < 45.0) AND (rPolishingElapsed_Sec > 4.0) THEN
        bTrip_SlurryStarve_Latched := TRUE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;

    (* 4. Spindle Reaction Torque Spike: Wafer shudder or pad delamination *)
    IF rCarrierTorque_Filt_Nm > 42.0 THEN
        bTrip_TorqueSpike_Latched := TRUE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;

    (* 5. Membrane Pneumatic Rupture: Large discrepancy between commanded and actual chamber pressure *)
    IF (ABS(rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa - rPressureFbk_Zone1_kPa) > 18.0) OR
       (ABS(rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa - rPressureFbk_Zone6_kPa) > 18.0) OR
       (ABS(rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa - rPressureFbk_Zone7_kPa) > 18.0) THEN
        bTrip_MembraneRupture_Latched := TRUE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Operator Diagnostic Reset & Latch Clear Handler *)
IF bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
    IF bEmergencyStop THEN
        bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rCarrierVacuum_kPa <= 30.0 THEN
        bTrip_WaferSlip_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rPadTemperature_degC < 48.0 THEN
        bTrip_PadOverheat_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rSlurryFlow_Filt_mLmin > 120.0 THEN
        bTrip_SlurryStarve_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rCarrierTorque_Filt_Nm < 20.0 THEN
        bTrip_TorqueSpike_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    bTrip_MembraneRupture_Latched := FALSE;
    bTrip_OverpolishPunch_Latched := FALSE;
    bTrip_TotalSpectroLoss_Latched := FALSE;
    IF (NOT bTrip_Hardwire_Latched) AND (NOT bTrip_WaferSlip_Latched) AND
       (NOT bTrip_PadOverheat_Latched) AND (NOT bTrip_SlurryStarve_Latched) AND
       (NOT bTrip_TorqueSpike_Latched) THEN
        bEmergencyTripActive := FALSE;
        wTripAlarmBitmask := 16#0000;
    END_IF;

        rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin := 0.0;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.4: Carrier Spindle Motor Drive Torque 2oo3 Voting                               *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_Torque_ChA AND bHealth_Torque_ChB AND bHealth_Torque_ChC THEN
    IF (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA >= rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB) THEN
        IF (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB >= rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC) THEN
            rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB;
        ELSIF (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA >= rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC) THEN
            rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC;
        ELSE
            rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA >= rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC) THEN
            rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA;
        ELSIF (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB >= rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC) THEN
            rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC;
        ELSE
            rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA - rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB) > rTOL_Torque_Nm) OR
       (ABS(rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB - rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC) > rTOL_Torque_Nm) OR
       (ABS(rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA - rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC) > rTOL_Torque_Nm) THEN
        rTimer_Torque_Discrepancy := rTimer_Torque_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_Torque_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA - rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm) > rTOL_Torque_Nm THEN
                bHealth_Torque_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB - rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm) > rTOL_Torque_Nm THEN
                bHealth_Torque_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_Torque_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_Torque_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_Torque_ChA AND bHealth_Torque_ChB) THEN
    rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := 0.5 * (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA + rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_Torque_ChA AND bHealth_Torque_ChC) THEN
    rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := 0.5 * (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA + rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_Torque_ChB AND bHealth_Torque_ChC) THEN
    rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := 0.5 * (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB + rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_Torque_ChA THEN
        rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_Torque_ChB THEN
        rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_Torque_ChC THEN
        rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC;
    ELSE
        rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := 0.0;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Digital Low-Pass Smoothing Filters *)
rThickness_Filt_nm     := (rFilterWeight * rThickness_Voted_nm)     + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rThickness_Filt_nm);
rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm  := (rFilterWeight * rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm)  + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm);
rSlurryFlow_Filt_mLmin := (rFilterWeight * rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin) + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rSlurryFlow_Filt_mLmin);
rCarrierTorque_Filt_Nm := (rFilterWeight * rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm) + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rCarrierTorque_Filt_Nm);

(* Map Array of Multi-Zone Process Thicknesses *)
rZoneThicknessArray[1] := rThickness_Filt_nm;
rZoneThicknessArray[2] := rThickness_Zone2_nm;
rZoneThicknessArray[3] := rThickness_Zone3_nm;
rZoneThicknessArray[4] := rThickness_Zone4_nm;
rZoneThicknessArray[5] := rThickness_Zone5_nm;
rZoneThicknessArray[6] := rThickness_Zone6_nm;
rZoneThicknessArray[7] := rThickness_Zone7_nm;
rFilmThicknessResidual_nm := rThickness_Filt_nm;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: SLURRY NANO-ABRASIVE SHEAR RATE TRIBOLOGY & CONTACT MECHANICS                     *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Kinematic Relative Velocities Across 7 Concentric Carrier Membrane Zones:                     *)
(* V_rel(r) = sqrt( (omega_platen * R_offset)^2 + (omega_platen - omega_carrier)^2 * r^2 )        *)
rRelVelocityCenter_m_s := (rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm * 0.104719755) * rCarrierOffsetDistance_m;

rZoneVelocity_m_s[1] := SQRT(EXPT(rRelVelocityCenter_m_s, 2.0) + EXPT(((rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - rCarrierSpeed_rpm) * 0.104719755) * rRadius_Zone1_m, 2.0));
rZoneVelocity_m_s[2] := SQRT(EXPT(rRelVelocityCenter_m_s, 2.0) + EXPT(((rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - rCarrierSpeed_rpm) * 0.104719755) * rRadius_Zone2_m, 2.0));
rZoneVelocity_m_s[3] := SQRT(EXPT(rRelVelocityCenter_m_s, 2.0) + EXPT(((rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - rCarrierSpeed_rpm) * 0.104719755) * rRadius_Zone3_m, 2.0));
rZoneVelocity_m_s[4] := SQRT(EXPT(rRelVelocityCenter_m_s, 2.0) + EXPT(((rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - rCarrierSpeed_rpm) * 0.104719755) * rRadius_Zone4_m, 2.0));
rZoneVelocity_m_s[5] := SQRT(EXPT(rRelVelocityCenter_m_s, 2.0) + EXPT(((rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - rCarrierSpeed_rpm) * 0.104719755) * rRadius_Zone5_m, 2.0));
rZoneVelocity_m_s[6] := SQRT(EXPT(rRelVelocityCenter_m_s, 2.0) + EXPT(((rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - rCarrierSpeed_rpm) * 0.104719755) * rRadius_Zone6_m, 2.0));
rZoneVelocity_m_s[7] := SQRT(EXPT(rRelVelocityCenter_m_s, 2.0) + EXPT(((rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - rCarrierSpeed_rpm) * 0.104719755) * rRadius_Zone7_m, 2.0));

(* Mean Hydrodynamic Slurry Shear Rate: gamma_dot = V_rel / h_lub [1/s] *)
IF rSlurryFilmThickness_m > 1.0E-6 THEN
    rSlurryShearRate_Local := rZoneVelocity_m_s[4] / rSlurryFilmThickness_m;
ELSE
    rSlurryShearRate_Local := 45000.0;
END_IF;
rShearRate_SecInv := rSlurryShearRate_Local;

(* Non-Newtonian Carreau-Yasuda Rheology Model:                                                  *)
(* mu(gamma_dot) = mu_inf + (mu_0 - mu_inf) * [ 1 + (lambda * gamma_dot)^2 ]^((n - 1) / 2)       *)
rApparentViscosity_PaS := rMu_InfShear_PaS + ((rMu_ZeroShear_PaS - rMu_InfShear_PaS) *
    EXPT((1.0 + EXPT(rCarreau_Lambda_Sec * rSlurryShearRate_Local, 2.0)), ((rCarreau_PowerIndex_n - 1.0) / 2.0)));
rSlurryDynamicViscosity_mPaS := rApparentViscosity_PaS * 1000.0;

(* Stribeck Lubrication Parameter: S = (mu * V_rel) / P_avg *)
IF rPressureFbk_Zone4_kPa > 1.0 THEN
    rStribeckNumber := (rApparentViscosity_PaS * rZoneVelocity_m_s[4]) / (rPressureFbk_Zone4_kPa * 1000.0);
ELSE
    rStribeckNumber := 0.0001;
END_IF;

(* Total Downward Normal Force & Friction Coefficient Mu:                                        *)
(* F_N = Sum( P_i * Area_i ) + P_RR * Area_RR                                                   *)
rTotalVerticalDownforce_N :=
    (rPressureFbk_Zone1_kPa * 0.001963) +
    (rPressureFbk_Zone2_kPa * 0.007540) +
    (rPressureFbk_Zone3_kPa * 0.012252) +
    (rPressureFbk_Zone4_kPa * 0.016022) +
    (rPressureFbk_Zone5_kPa * 0.015243) +
    (rPressureFbk_Zone6_kPa * 0.008126) +
    (rPressureFbk_Zone7_kPa * 0.001407) +
    (rPressureFbk_RetRing_kPa * 0.031102);
rTotalVerticalDownforce_N := rTotalVerticalDownforce_N * 1000.0; (* Convert kPa*m^2 to N *)

(* Friction Force F_f = Torque / R_offset *)
IF rCarrierOffsetDistance_m > 0.05 THEN
    rFrictionForce_N := rCarrierTorque_Filt_Nm / rCarrierOffsetDistance_m;
ELSE
    rFrictionForce_N := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Instantaneous Friction Coefficient Mu = F_friction / F_normal *)
IF rTotalVerticalDownforce_N > 50.0 THEN
    rCurrentFrictionCoeff_Mu := rFrictionForce_N / rTotalVerticalDownforce_N;
    IF rCurrentFrictionCoeff_Mu > 0.85 THEN
        rCurrentFrictionCoeff_Mu := 0.85;
    ELSIF rCurrentFrictionCoeff_Mu < 0.05 THEN
        rCurrentFrictionCoeff_Mu := 0.05;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCurrentFrictionCoeff_Mu := 0.35;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Pad Micro-Asperity Glaze Saturation Index Tracking *)
IF (iStateStep >= 40) AND (iStateStep <= 50) THEN
    rPadGlazingIndex_Pct := rPadGlazingIndex_Pct +
        (rPadGlazeRateCoeff * rCurrentFrictionCoeff_Mu * rZoneVelocity_m_s[4] * tScanDeltaTime_Sec) -
        (rConditionerCutoffCoeff * (rConditionerDownforce_N / 45.0) * (rConditionerSweepFreq_Hz / 0.35) * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
    IF rPadGlazingIndex_Pct > 100.0 THEN
        rPadGlazingIndex_Pct := 100.0;
    ELSIF rPadGlazingIndex_Pct < 0.0 THEN
        rPadGlazingIndex_Pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: IN-SITU SPECTROSCOPIC THICKNESS PROFILING & MULTI-ZONE ENDPOINT DETECTION (EPD)   *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Shift 5-Point Thickness History Buffer for Savitzky-Golay Linear Regression Slope *)
rThicknessBuffer_Center[5] := rThicknessBuffer_Center[4];
rThicknessBuffer_Center[4] := rThicknessBuffer_Center[3];
rThicknessBuffer_Center[3] := rThicknessBuffer_Center[2];
rThicknessBuffer_Center[2] := rThicknessBuffer_Center[1];
rThicknessBuffer_Center[1] := rThickness_Filt_nm;

(* Least-Squares 1st Derivative: slope = [ 2*(y1 - y5) + (y2 - y4) ] / (10 * dt) [nm/s] *)
IF tScanDeltaTime_Sec > 0.001 THEN
    rSlope_Derivative_nm_s :=
        (2.0 * (rThicknessBuffer_Center[1] - rThicknessBuffer_Center[5]) +
         1.0 * (rThicknessBuffer_Center[2] - rThicknessBuffer_Center[4])) / (10.0 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
    (* Convert nm/s to Angstrom/min: RR = -slope * 10 [Angstrom/nm] * 60 [s/min] *)
    rEstimatedRemovalRate_AngstromMin := -1.0 * rSlope_Derivative_nm_s * 600.0;
    IF rEstimatedRemovalRate_AngstromMin < 0.0 THEN
        rEstimatedRemovalRate_AngstromMin := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rEstimatedRemovalRate_AngstromMin := 2800.0;
END_IF;

(* 2nd Derivative Curvature: inflection point indicates barrier breakthrough *)
rCurvature_2ndDeriv := (rThicknessBuffer_Center[1] - (2.0 * rThicknessBuffer_Center[3]) + rThicknessBuffer_Center[5]) /
    EXPT(2.0 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec, 2.0);

(* Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) Across 7 Concentric Radial Zones *)
rSum := 0.0;
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
    rSum := rSum + rZoneThicknessArray[iIdx];
END_FOR;
rMeanThick := rSum / 7.0;

rVariance := 0.0;
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
    rVariance := rVariance + EXPT(rZoneThicknessArray[iIdx] - rMeanThick, 2.0);
END_FOR;
rStdDev := SQRT(rVariance / 7.0);

IF rMeanThick > 0.1 THEN
    rWaferNonUniformity_WIWNU_Pct := (rStdDev / rMeanThick) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rWaferNonUniformity_WIWNU_Pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Spectroscopic EPD Trigger Detection *)
rEndpointThreshold_nm := rTargetFinalThickness_nm + rAllowedOverpolish_nm;
IF (rThickness_Filt_nm <= rEndpointThreshold_nm) AND (iStateStep == 40) THEN
    bEndpointDetected := TRUE;
    rEndpointConfidence_Pct := 98.4;
    iStateStep := 50; (* Transition to SELECTIVE_BUFF_OVERPOLISH *)
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE KALMAN STATE OBSERVER UPDATE                            *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 1. Innovation Error: y_meas - C_d * x_pred *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 7 DO
    (* Nominal target thickness trajectory difference in Angstroms: 1 nm = 10 Angstroms *)
    rInnovation[iRow] := ((rZoneThicknessArray[iRow] - rTargetFinalThickness_nm) * 10.0) - xState_Pred[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* 2. Measurement State Correction: x_est = x_pred + L * Innovation *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
    rSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 7 DO
        rSum := rSum + (mL_Gain[iRow, iCol] * rInnovation[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Est[iRow] := xState_Pred[iRow] + rSum;
    xState[iRow] := xState_Est[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* 3. Disturbance Vector Extraction *)
dDisturbance[1] := rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - 90.0;
dDisturbance[2] := rSlurryFlow_Filt_mLmin - 250.0;
dDisturbance[3] := rConditionerDownforce_N - 45.0;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: MULTIVARIABLE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) 7-ZONE PRESSURE OPTIMIZER           *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Solve Projected Gradient Quadratic Programming Step deterministically *)
IF (iStateStep == 40) OR (iStateStep == 50) THEN
    (* Target trajectory: drive thickness error to zero *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        xState_Ref[iIdx] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;
    xState_Ref[8] := 0.0; (* Regulate pad temp to nominal 38 deg C *)

    (* Projected Gradient Descent Iteration Loop *)
    FOR iQPIter := 1 TO iMaxQPIter DO
        (* One-step forward prediction: x_pred = A_d * x_est + B_d * u + E_d * d *)
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
            rSum := 0.0;
            FOR iCol := 1 TO 8 DO
                rSum := rSum + (mA_d[iRow, iCol] * xState_Est[iCol]);
            END_FOR;
            FOR iCol := 1 TO 7 DO
                rSum := rSum + (mB_d[iRow, iCol] * uControl[iCol]);
            END_FOR;
            FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
                rSum := rSum + (mE_d[iRow, iCol] * dDisturbance[iCol]);
            END_FOR;
            xState_Pred[iRow] := rSum;
        END_FOR;

        (* Compute Gradient: Grad_u = B_d^T * Q * (x_pred - x_ref) + R * u + S * (u - u_prev) *)
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 7 DO
            rSum := 0.0;
            FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
                rSum := rSum + (mB_d[iRow, iCol] * vQ_Diag[iRow] * (xState_Pred[iRow] - xState_Ref[iRow]));
            END_FOR;
            rSum := rSum + (vR_Diag[iCol] * uControl[iCol]) + (vS_Diag[iCol] * (uControl[iCol] - uControl_Prev[iCol]));

            (* Edge Roll-Off Barrier Penalty: Penalize excessive pressure differential between Zone 6 and 7 *)
            IF iCol == 7 THEN
                rEdgeShearDeltaP_kPa := uControl[7] - uControl[6];
                IF ABS(rEdgeShearDeltaP_kPa) > 4.5 THEN
                    rSum := rSum + (rRhoEdgePenalty * (rEdgeShearDeltaP_kPa - 4.5));
                END_IF;
            END_IF;
            rGradJ[iCol] := rSum;
        END_FOR;

        (* Gradient Descent Update with Projection into Feasible Pressure Bounds *)
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 7 DO
            uControl[iCol] := uControl[iCol] - (rAlphaStep * rGradJ[iCol]);
            (* Enforce Actuator Slew Rate Constraints *)
            IF (uControl[iCol] - uControl_Prev[iCol]) > rMaxDeltaP_PerScan THEN
                uControl[iCol] := uControl_Prev[iCol] + rMaxDeltaP_PerScan;
            ELSIF (uControl[iCol] - uControl_Prev[iCol]) < -rMaxDeltaP_PerScan THEN
                uControl[iCol] := uControl_Prev[iCol] - rMaxDeltaP_PerScan;
            END_IF;
            (* Enforce Absolute Pressure Bounds [rPressureMin_kPa - 20.0, rPressureMax_kPa - 20.0] *)
            IF uControl[iCol] > (rPressureMax_kPa - 20.0) THEN
                uControl[iCol] := rPressureMax_kPa - 20.0;
            ELSIF uControl[iCol] < (rPressureMin_kPa - 20.0) THEN
                uControl[iCol] := rPressureMin_kPa - 20.0;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Store Previous Control Setpoint for Slew Penalty *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 7 DO
        uControl_Prev[iCol] := uControl[iCol];
    END_FOR;

    (* Decouple Pneumatic Cross-Talk: P_valves = M_decouple * (P_baseline + uControl) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 7 DO
        rSum := 0.0;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 7 DO
            rTargetZoneP_kPa := 20.0 + uControl[iCol];
            rSum := rSum + (mMembraneDecouple[iRow, iCol] * rTargetZoneP_kPa);
        END_FOR;
        uControl_Decoupled[iRow] := rSum;
    END_FOR;
ELSE
    (* Default Idle / Zero Deviation Pressure Commands *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 7 DO
        uControl[iCol] := 0.0;
        uControl_Prev[iCol] := 0.0;
        uControl_Decoupled[iCol] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) SEQUENCE ENGINE                            *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
CASE iStateStep OF
    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_IDLE *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bPolishingActive            := FALSE;
        bEndpointDetected           := FALSE;
        bOverpolishActive           := FALSE;
        bWaferChuckedOk             := FALSE;
        rPlatenSpeed_Cmd_rpm        := 0.0;
        rCarrierSpeed_Cmd_rpm       := 0.0;
        rSlurryFlow_Cmd_mLmin       := 0.0;
        rDIWaterFlow_Cmd_mLmin      := 0.0;
        rConditionerDownforce_Cmd_N := 0.0;
        rConditionerSweep_Cmd_Hz    := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa      := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone2_kPa      := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone3_kPa      := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone4_kPa      := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone5_kPa      := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa      := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa      := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_RetainingRing_kPa := 0.0;
        rStateTimer_Sec             := 0.0;
        rPolishingElapsed_Sec       := 0.0;
        IF bEnable AND (NOT bEmergencyTripActive) AND (iTargetOperatingMode == 1) THEN
            iStateStep := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_WAFER_CHUCK_AND_VACUUM_SEAL_VERIFY *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        (* Apply vacuum to chuck wafer onto membrane backing film *)
        IF rCarrierVacuum_kPa <= 25.0 THEN
            bWaferChuckedOk := TRUE;
            IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 2.0 THEN
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
                iStateStep := 20;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            bWaferChuckedOk := FALSE;
            IF rStateTimer_Sec > 8.0 THEN
                bTrip_WaferSlip_Latched := TRUE;
                bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
                iStateStep := 90;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_SLURRY_PREWET_AND_PAD_CONDITIONER_START *)
        rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        (* Spin platen and deliver chemical slurry to form uniform fluid boundary *)
        rPlatenSpeed_Cmd_rpm        := 90.0;
        rCarrierSpeed_Cmd_rpm       := 85.0;
        rSlurryFlow_Cmd_mLmin       := 250.0;
        rDIWaterFlow_Cmd_mLmin      := 0.0;
        rConditionerDownforce_Cmd_N := 45.0;
        rConditionerSweep_Cmd_Hz    := 0.35;
        IF (rStateTimer_Sec >= 5.0) AND (rSlurryFlow_Filt_mLmin >= 200.0) AND (rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm >= 88.0) THEN
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            iStateStep := 30;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_CARRIER_DESCENT_AND_SOFT_LANDING_TOUCHDOWN *)
        rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        (* Controlled soft-touch contact landing with minimal initial downforce *)
        rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa := 5.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone2_kPa := 5.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone3_kPa := 5.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone4_kPa := 5.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone5_kPa := 5.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa := 5.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa := 5.0;
        rPressureCmd_RetainingRing_kPa := 10.0;
        IF rCarrierTorque_Filt_Nm >= 4.0 THEN
            rTouchdownSettleTimer_Sec := rTouchdownSettleTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            IF rTouchdownSettleTimer_Sec >= 1.5 THEN
                rTouchdownSettleTimer_Sec := 0.0;
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
                bPolishingActive := TRUE;
                iStateStep := 40;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rTouchdownSettleTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_DYNAMIC_7ZONE_MPC_MAIN_POLISH *)
        bPolishingActive      := TRUE;
        rStateTimer_Sec       := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        rPolishingElapsed_Sec := rPolishingElapsed_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        (* Apply decoupled multivariable MPC pressure commands across 7 zones *)
        rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[1];
        rPressureCmd_Zone2_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[2];
        rPressureCmd_Zone3_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[3];
        rPressureCmd_Zone4_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[4];
        rPressureCmd_Zone5_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[5];
        rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[6];
        rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[7];
        (* Retaining ring follows outer edge zone pressure plus offset to arrest pad rebound *)
        rPressureCmd_RetainingRing_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[7] + 6.5;
        rPlatenSpeed_Cmd_rpm        := 90.0;
        rCarrierSpeed_Cmd_rpm       := 85.0;
        rSlurryFlow_Cmd_mLmin       := 250.0;
        rConditionerDownforce_Cmd_N := 45.0;
        rConditionerSweep_Cmd_Hz    := 0.35;
        (* Safety watchdog timeout: max polishing time = 120.0 seconds *)
        IF rPolishingElapsed_Sec > 120.0 THEN
            bTrip_OverpolishPunch_Latched := TRUE;
            bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
            iStateStep := 90;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_ENDPOINT_APPROACH_SELECTIVE_OVERPOLISH_AND_BUFF *)
        bOverpolishActive := TRUE;
        rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        rOverpolishTimer_Sec := rOverpolishTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        (* Soft touch buff: reduce bulk downforce to prevent dishing and erosion *)
        rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa := 8.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone2_kPa := 8.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone3_kPa := 8.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone4_kPa := 8.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone5_kPa := 8.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa := 8.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa := 7.5;
        rPressureCmd_RetainingRing_kPa := 12.0;
        (* Transition out after selective buff duration (nominal 4.5 seconds) *)
        IF (rOverpolishTimer_Sec >= 4.5) OR (rThickness_Filt_nm <= rTargetFinalThickness_nm) THEN
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            bPolishingActive := FALSE;
            iStateStep := 60;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_POST_POLISH_HIGH_PRESSURE_DIW_RINSE *)
        rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        bPolishingActive := FALSE;
        bOverpolishActive := FALSE;
        (* Shut off slurry and activate high-pressure DI water to flush nano-abrasives *)
        rSlurryFlow_Cmd_mLmin  := 0.0;
        rDIWaterFlow_Cmd_mLmin := 1800.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa := 3.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone2_kPa := 3.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone3_kPa := 3.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone4_kPa := 3.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone5_kPa := 3.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa := 3.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa := 3.0;
        rPressureCmd_RetainingRing_kPa := 4.0;
        rConditionerDownforce_Cmd_N := 0.0;
        rConditionerSweep_Cmd_Hz := 0.0;
        IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 8.0 THEN
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            iStateStep := 70;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_DECHUCK_WATER_SURFACE_TENSION_RELEASE *)
        rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        (* Vent membrane downforce and apply gentle carrier pocket positive pressure to release surface tension *)
        rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone2_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone3_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone4_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone5_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_RetainingRing_kPa := 0.0;
        rPlatenSpeed_Cmd_rpm := 20.0;
        rCarrierSpeed_Cmd_rpm := 15.0;
        IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 3.0 THEN
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            iStateStep := 80;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_CARRIER_RETRACT_AND_METROLOGY_HANDSHAKE *)
        rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        rPlatenSpeed_Cmd_rpm := 0.0;
        rCarrierSpeed_Cmd_rpm := 0.0;
        rDIWaterFlow_Cmd_mLmin := 0.0;
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        (* Handshake with track wafer transfer robot *)
        IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 2.0 THEN
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            iStateStep := 0; (* Cycle completed successfully, return to STANDBY *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_RETRACT_BLOWDOWN_TRIP *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bPolishingActive := FALSE;
        bOverpolishActive := FALSE;
        (* Rapid pneumatic de-pressurization of all zones to prevent wafer breakage *)
        rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone2_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone3_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone4_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone5_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_RetainingRing_kPa := 0.0;
        rPlatenSpeed_Cmd_rpm := 0.0;
        rCarrierSpeed_Cmd_rpm := 0.0;
        rSlurryFlow_Cmd_mLmin := 0.0;
        rDIWaterFlow_Cmd_mLmin := 500.0; (* Maintain rinse to prevent slurry drying on wafer *)
        rConditionerDownforce_Cmd_N := 0.0;
        rConditionerSweep_Cmd_Hz := 0.0;
        IF (NOT bEmergencyTripActive) AND (NOT bTrip_Hardwire_Latched) THEN
            iStateStep := 0;
        END_IF;
END_CASE;
